S.FORM: Columbia hya' ga cyux maki' tay 4 00 N, 72 00 W na Nan-Meco syuw. kwara' kinghciyan niya' 1,138,910 sq km (maki' tay 26ginkgan kin wahci') (kinwhci' niya' ga 1,038,700 sq km , kinwhci' na lawsayan wsilung hya' ga 100,210 sq km) Kinkhmayan kwara' squliq hya' ga 47,220,856.
